$comment: INERT planning example. Not registered, not loaded, not wired into any code. A complete, plausible PluginManifest for a FUTURE AI assistant plugin, mirroring the marketplace contract (crates/server/src/plugins/manifest.rs). Field names stay English (marketplace surface); host PROJECTUS domain identifiers (nota, projeto, tarefa, titulo, notas) are untouched.
title: AI Assistant
short_description: Summarize, rewrite and ask questions across your notes, projects and tasks.
long_description: AI Assistant brings a writing and reasoning companion into PROJECTUS. From the markdown editor, select text to summarize, rewrite, expand or translate via slash and toolbar actions. From a routed chat screen, ask questions grounded in your own nota, projeto and tarefa content. A global-search provider answers natural-language queries over the workspace. Provider API keys are stored in the host secret store, all model calls go out over the network, and longer jobs (workspace-wide summaries) run as background jobs. The plugin only reads host entities; any results you keep are written back through the standard host APIs, never directly to disk.
author: PROJECTUS Labs
changelog:
0.6.0 - Workspace-grounded chat screen.
0.5.0 - Editor slash actions (summarize, rewrite).
0.4.0 - Provider keys in host secret store.
